Name: Money Sinks - Books for Dark Offerings
Author: Nullnnow
Description:
[size=4][size=3]This is an add-on to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45404?tab=bugs]Money Sinks - Dark Offerings[/url] which adds [b]over 50[/b] new books, 2 new trinkets, several new monsters, various secrets, an ARG, and more! Below is a list of all of the books sold by the shrine.[/size][/size]
[spoiler][size=4][size=3][b]Elven Farming.[/b] Allows Ancient Fruit to grow during winter.
[b]Diary of a Wimpy Sommelier.[/b] Kegs will now produce silver quality wine.
[b]Pickled Delights.[/b] Pickles can now be aged. They age twice as fast as wine.
[b]Morduu's Tome of Trees.[/b] Allows you to use tree fertilizer on fruit trees.
[b]Hamlet.[/b] Let's you feed golden animal crackers to pigs, giving them a chance of digging up two truffles at a time.
[b]40 Hues of Slime.[/b] Increase the capacity of Slime Hutches by 10.
[b]Deadeye.[/b] Allows for faster slingshot reloading.
[b]Prairie King. [/b]Prevents slingshots from consuming ammo.
[b]A Fisher's Delight.[/b] Fishing rods will no longer consume bait and tackles no longer lose durability.
[b]Tusk Love.[/b] Improves bone mills! Providing artifacts produces better fertilizer.
[b]Fighter Cats - Might of Five.[/b] Makes calico statues more likely to spawn during the Desert Festival.
[b]Geologist's Handbook - Volumes I & II.[/b] Makes crystalariums operate faster and increase the stone dropped from rocks respectively.
[b]The Tinkerer's Treat.[/b] Increases the likelihood of getting better trinkets when using the anvil. Also unlocks two new trinkets, the Dragon Claw and the Lightning Spur.
[b]Well Wishes.[/b] Turns wells into wishing wells, allowing you to toss in a small amount of money to get luck buff that lasts all day.
[b]Over the Garden Pond.[/b] Increases the output of fish ponds with 10 or more fish.
[b]Parenting 101.[/b] Reading this books grants friendship to all of your kids.
[b]The Medium Sapling.[/b] Eating the crops from seed spots (carrots, broccoli, summer squash, and powder melon) grants a buff. This buff stacks with other food and drink buffs, but not with each other. Requires you to have read "The Little Sapling."
[b]Secrets of the Fey.[/b] You craft thrice as much fairy dust.
[b]Secrets of the Archfey.[/b] Using fairy dust on machines causes it to produce an additional item. Has no effect on casks.
[b]Book of Vows.[/b] Your spouse's friendship will no longer decay.
[b]Old as Dirt. [/b]Seed spots occasionally also spawn artifacts.
[b]Busy as a Bee.[/b] Increases the number of flowers harvested based on the number of nearby bee houses. More information on how this book works can be found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/4432]here[/url].
[b]Secrets of the Junimo. [/b]Raisin-fed Junimos have a greater chance of harvesting double crops, and a slight chance of harvesting triple crops.
[b]Ballad of the Missing Shorts Acts I-IV.[/b] A series of books that modify Lewis' basement.[/size][/size][/spoiler]
[size=4][size=3]There are also several books sold elsewhere. Below is a list of each of these books alongside who sells them.[/size][/size]
[spoiler][size=4][size=3]Books sold at the book store:
[b]Eye of the Beholder.[/b] Increases the price of monster loot.
[b]The Little Sapling.[/b] Seed spots have a chance of also producing clay, fiber, or stone.
[b]Prime Time Access.[/b] Unlocks the "Junimo and Friends" and "Movies" TV channels. Watching "Junimo and Friends" will increase your friendship with your kids, alongside your spouse if they are in the same building as you. The "Movies" channel displays random movies. It is a cosmetic channel that can be ran in the background (i.e., it doesn't lock the player in place).
[b]Super Fashion Girl.[/b] Displays what article of clothing can be tailored from an item and whether you've made said item yet.
[b]Princess Strawberry. [/b]Strawberries are added to Pierre's spring seed selection. It is available starting year 2.[/size][/size]

Books sold at the Adventurer's Guild:
[b]Improvised Weapons I & II. [/b]Increase the damage dealt by tools. More information on how this works can be found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/4431]here[/url].

Books sold by Marnie:
[b]Sky Buddy.[/b] Pets gain friendship faster and are more likely to find items once at max friendship.
[b]Quality Boops. [/b]Auto petters provide a passive increase to an animal's friendship.

Books sold Alex at the ice cream stand:
[b]Swift Swim.[/b] Allows you to run while in your bathing suit (i.e., while in the bath house).
[b]Sweat Treats.[/b] Ice cream grants more friendship when gifted on a sunny Summer day. It also becomes a loved gift by Jas, Vincent, and Leo.

Books sold by Sandy:
[b]Flower Power.[/b] Increases the friendship gained from gifting flowers.

Books sold by the traveling merchant:
[b]Portraiture.[/b] The traveling merchant sells a random spouse portrait on Sundays.
[b]Expanded Stock.[/b] Increase the number of items sold by the traveling merchant.

Books sold by Robin:
[b]Where the Sidewalk Starts.[/b] You craft twice as many paths and fences.
[b]Milleficent. [/b]Doubles the output of mills.

Books sold at the Saloon:
[b]Grandma's Cook Book.[/b] Increases the price of cooked foods.
[b]Chef's Digest.[/b] Display how much of an item you still need for cooking recipes. 

Books sold by Willy:
[b]Good Eats.[/b] Increases the price of crabs, lobsters, crab cakes, lobster bisque, and caviar.

Books sold at festivals:
[b]The Power of Friendship [/b](Desert Festival). Increases the power of weapons sold at the Desert Festival based on how much friendship you have with the weapon's corresponding NPC.
[b]The Pumpkin King[/b] (Spirit's Eve). Jack-O-Lanterns that you've placed will never rot.
[b]Spirits of Pumpkins Past[/b] (Spirit's Eve). The chest at the end of the Spirit's Eve maze will always contain a golden pumpkin and 3 prize tickets.[/spoiler]
[size=4][size=3]Alongside a few other secret books![/size][/size]

[size=4][size=3]This mod also adds the following two trinkets:[/size][/size]
[spoiler][size=4][size=3][b]Dragon's Claw.[/b] Obtained by placing a Basilisk Paw in an anvil. Equipping it grants you immunity to debuffs alongside granting you a buff to one of your skills.
[b]Lightning Spur.[/b] Allows you to either manually activate or toggle a buff to your speed. By default, this behavior is controlled by the space bar.[/size][/size][/spoiler]

[size=4][size=3]As per usual with all of my Money Sinks mods, there is an option to make the books cheaper.[/size][/size]

[size=4][size=3]Want more mods to spend large sums of money in? Then check out the other mods in the Money Sinks series of mods![/size][/size]
